<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="finalized" xml:id="ex44012024-1114" part="F"><lg><l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4028">blo brtan</rs> nas bzung <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3977">nam mkha</rs>'i mtshan can dang ||</l> 
            <l>blo gros shes bya kun la dpag <lb n="1b4"/> med rgyas ||</l> 
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4007">bzang po</rs>'i mtshan can <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4016">kho'o</rs>'i yongs 'dzin dang ||</l> 
            <l>brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal nas ||</l>
            <l><rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3761">chos mngon mdzod</rs> la sbyor Tig cung zad tsam ||</l> 
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4016">bdag</rs> gi 'di dag brtsam par <lb n="1b5"/> mi nus na'ang || </l>
            <l><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4007">mchims ston bla ma</rs>'i bzhed pa ji bzhin dang || </l>
            <l>gsung las byon cing TI kar ma thebs rnams ||</l> 
            <l>legs par bshad kyi blo gros ldan pa dag ||</l> 
            <l>rnam dpyod byed cing ngo gdong bshad 'di ltos ¦</l> </lg>
            <lb n="1b6"/> sbyor ba dang ¦ rtsod spong dang ¦ lung 'dren rnaMs mangs na <expan>yi ge</expan> mangs pas 'jigs pas ¦ cung zad bsdus te bshad par bya'o || </seg></TEI>
source: 2_044_01 chos mngon pa mdzod kyi sbyor tig.xml
